page.layout: Running head at top centre. Below it one copperplate engraving of a battle array, with plate labels. Under the engraving, three columns of key text (A to E, F to I, K to N), the third cut off at the right edge of the scan.

main_text.l: A. Equites sociorum, vtriusque cornu viginti Turmae.
F. Equites Romani, Turmae viginti vtriusq; legionis.
G. Equites Extraordinarij, vtriusq; cornu Turmae octo.

page.notes: The engraving shows a battle line with letters and labels (A to Q, T, V) that are plate letters, not text, and are not transcribed. The right edge of the scan cuts off the running head, the third key column and the ends of lines K, L and N, so those lines are incomplete. The legend has some italic and roman type mixed, as printed. Long s and u/v have been normalised, and the first plate label ("Cornu sinistr.") is hard to read, so it may be inexact.
